As DKD progresses, plasma zinc levels decline ( 26, 152–154).
Low zinc levels are negatively correlated with the expression of nod-
like receptor nucleotide-binding domain and leucine-rich repeat
pyrin-3 domain (NLRP3), IL-1 b, and IL-18 ( 155) and are currently

retrospective cohort study using the TriNetX Analytics Network
demonstrated that zinc de ﬁciency serves as an independent predic-
tor of DKD and affects kidney function through direct mechanisms
rather than via microvascular dysfunction or poor metabolic
control (159). This ﬁnding is particularly important, as it indicates
that zinc de ﬁciency represents an independent therapeutic target
rather than merely a marker of overall diabetes severity.
